use_case_summary: Real-time collaborative editor assistance + document search. Chat for contextual suggestions, reranking for search results, embeddings for similarity. Need consistent conversational state across model variants; maintain prompt-engineered guardrails.
requirements: - Latency target: 95th perc ≤ 220ms for short-turn chat (avg token length 12). - Throughput: bursty concurrent sessions up to 4k qps during peak. - Cost sensitivity: target <50% of current per-token cost at 200M tokens/mo. - Model parity: match baseline model responses within human eval thresholds; minimize rerank swaps. - Routing: initial Hosted, then route to Dedicated in same region. - Data controls: must support KMS-managed keys and retention controls (90d), and per-tenant data isolation on Dedicated.
migration_concerns: - API compatibility: current provider exposes streaming + deltas + custom function-calling semantics. - Prompt parity: small tokenization/model id differences causing output drift. - Regressions: reranking order changes impact UX; need automated regression alerts. - Telemetry: need identical token and cost accounting to compare spend. - Rollout plan: canary A/B, fallback to old provider if regressions exceed threshold.
poc_notes: POC metrics to capture: BLEU/ROUGE-like similarity for completions, rerank precision@5, latency p50/p95, cost per 1k tokens. Team wants a scriptable harness (we provided runbook link).
